//Bug 7218 Helper to keep the current filters in sync with the URL
//Called whenever a filter changes or is cleared
//Lets browser back/forward and reload restore the same filter state
function updateFilterInUrl(paramName, value) {
    const url = new URL(window.location.href);

    if (value == null || value === '') {
        url.searchParams.delete(paramName);
    } else {
        url.searchParams.set(paramName, value);
    }

    // Replace current entry without reloading
    window.history.replaceState({}, '', url.toString());
}

//Dept Type change handler
//Bug 7218: Updated method logic. Keeps deptType in sync with URL, rebuilds the dept dropdown, selects the correct dept from the savedDeptOverride parm (restoring from URL) or the dept query param in the URL
function onDeptTypeChange(e){

    // Is this a real user change (jQuery event) or a programmatic call from initFiltersFromUrl?
    const isUserChange = !!(e && e.originalEvent);

    // Get selected Dept Type
    let primaryValue = $("#dropdownfilter_0 option:selected").val();

    console.log("[onDeptTypeChange] selected deptType:", primaryValue, "isUserChange:", isUserChange);

    // Write Dept Type to URL
    updateFilterInUrl('deptType', primaryValue);

    // If the USER changed the dept type, then we clear the dept filter.
    // If this is initFiltersFromUrl calling us, we DO NOT clear dept,
    // because we want to reselect it from the URL.
    if (isUserChange) {
        $("#dropdownfilter_1").val("");
        updateFilterInUrl('dept', '');
    }

    // Clear all Dept options
    $("#dropdownfilter_1").empty();

    // Fallback default 
    if (!primaryValue) {
        primaryValue = 10;
        console.log("[onDeptTypeChange] deptType empty, defaulting to 10");
    }

    // Fetch Depts for this Dept Type
    $.getJSON("/depttypes-json/?id=" + primaryValue)
        .success(function (data) {
            console.log("[onDeptTypeChange] /depttypes-json result for deptType:", data);

            if (data.results.length > 0) {
                // Blank option at top
                let blankOption = document.createElement("option");
                $("#dropdownfilter_1").append(blankOption);

                // Build Dept options
                data.results.forEach(element => {
                    let option = document.createElement("option");
                    option.value = element.Id;       // Dept ID
                    option.innerText = element.Name; // Dept Name
                    $("#dropdownfilter_1").append(option);
                });
             // If this is NOT a user change (i.e., we're restoring from URL),
                // try to reselect the saved Dept.
                if (!isUserChange) {
                    const url = new URL(window.location.href);
                    let savedDept = url.searchParams.get('dept');
                    console.log("[onDeptTypeChange] savedDept from URL:", savedDept);

                    if (savedDept) {
                        // Normalize GUIDs: strip { } and lowercase
                        const normalizedSaved = savedDept.replace(/[{}]/g, '').toLowerCase();
                        let matchValue = null;

                        $('#dropdownfilter_1 option').each(function () {
                            const optionVal = (this.value || '').replace(/[{}]/g, '').toLowerCase();
                            if (optionVal === normalizedSaved) {
                                matchValue = this.value; // use actual DOM value
                                return false; // break out of .each()
                            }
                        });

                        if (matchValue) {
                            $('#dropdownfilter_1').val(matchValue);
                        } else {
                            console.warn(
                                "[onDeptTypeChange] saved dept from URL not found in options.",
                                "savedDept:", savedDept
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }) 
        .error(function (error) {
            console.error("[onDeptTypeChange] error loading depts for deptType:", error);
        });
}

    const url = new URL(window.location.href);

    console.log("[initFiltersFromUrl] deptType from URL:", deptType, "dept from URL:", dept);

        onDeptTypeChange(); // no event → isUserChange = false

}

			const pageSource = document.documentElement.outerHTML;
			const customPvaBotWebchatRegex = /api\.(preprod\.|test\.)?powerplatform\.(com|us|cn|appsplatform\.us)\/powervirtualagents\/botsbyschema\/([^/]+)\/directline\/token/;
			const customPvaBotIframeRegex = /powerva\.microsoft\.com\/environments\/([0-9a-fA-F\-]+)\/bots\/([^/]+)\/webchat/;
			const omniChannelRegex = /livechatwidget\/scripts\/LiveChatBootstrapper\.js/;

			const matchPvaBotWebchat = pageSource.match(customPvaBotWebchatRegex);
			if (matchPvaBotWebchat && matchPvaBotWebchat[3]) {
				trackCopilotCustomUsage(matchPvaBotWebchat[3]);
			}

			const matchPvaBotIframe = pageSource.match(customPvaBotIframeRegex);
			if (matchPvaBotIframe && matchPvaBotIframe[2]) {

				trackCopilotCustomUsage("omnichannelWidget");
			}

			findAndLogCustomCopilotUsage();
		});
